source_description_html:
Rebel Series Gen-3 engineering pushes case design to the absolute limit. Extreme durability in the thinnest & lightest frame possible. Our advanced chassis construction includes inner corner shock absorbers, microfiber sheet & raised 'claw' corners to protect every surface against all manner of falls. Metal buttons ensure satisfying clicks + improved dust resistance. Slimmer sides, grippier material texture, easy swipe borders & our signature angled pinky rest provide excellent comfort. MagSafe compatible with the strongest MagSafe hold on the market, 30% stronger vs original cases. All this wrapped in a meticulously sculpted design, if a case could be sexy.. this would be it. Your search for the ultimate iPhone case is over.

REBEL Red is limited edition! Only 1,000 units produced per size.
